clips.title: The story
paras: An Undelivered Letter is a piece of long-forgotten mail left behind in Goldshire's Lion's Pride Inn. Penned years ago by the elusive Stalvan Mistmantle, it serves as a critical clue in unraveling the dark tale of his past.

Years ago, a storm drove a traveling courier into the Lion's Pride Inn looking for dry lodging. Near midnight, the terrified messenger fled down the stairs in his sleeping clothes and vanished into the pouring rain, never to return. He abandoned a chest full of belongings on the second floor, including a letter written by Stalvan Mistmantle addressed to an estate in Stormwind City's Canal District.
